name: AI SEO Article Writer
author: Gumzo

sections.description:
AI SEO Article Writer is a powerful WordPress plugin that helps you create engaging, SEO-optimized blog content using artificial intelligence. With just a few clicks, you can generate well-researched, unique articles that rank well in search engines.

Key Features

  • AI-powered content generation
  • SEO optimization built-in
  • Customizable content parameters
  • Easy-to-use interface
  • Multiple content styles
  • Plagiarism-free content
  • Built-in editing capabilities

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.6 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher

External Services

This plugin connects to Gumzo AI services (api.gumzo.com) to generate and manage article content. These services are essential for the core functionality of the plugin.

What data is sent and when

  • Site Registration: When the plugin is first activated, basic site information is sent to api.gumzo.com including: site URL, site name, admin email, WordPress version, plugin version, language, timezone, and theme. This is used to generate your API key and set up your account.
  • User Information: The plugin periodically sends API key data to retrieve account information such as subscription status, auto-generation settings, and available features.
  • Article Generation: When generating articles (both manually and automatically), the plugin sends your API key, selected keywords, language preferences, and content parameters to the AI service.
  • Article Retrieval: The plugin uses your API key to fetch generated articles from the service.
  • Checkout Process: When purchasing premium plans, checkout information including your API key and selected plan is sent to the service.
  • User Settings: When updating settings, your preferences and API key are sent to update your account configuration.

No personal user data beyond what is specifically required for service functionality is transmitted. All communication with the API is done securely.

Service Provider

These services are provided by Gumzo AI:
* Terms of Service: https://api.gumzo.com/terms-of-service.php
* Privacy Policy: https://api.gumzo.com/privacy-policy.php

Privacy Policy

This plugin connects to external AI services to generate content. No personal data is shared with these services except what is necessary for content generation (such as your article topics and parameters).
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ai-seo-blog-article-writer directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Configure your API settings in the plugin settings page
  4. Start generating content from the plugin dashboard
